name: Procurement & invoicing
definition: Public procurement and payment to suppliers.
challenges: Fraud and collusion in procurement are significant; opacity in contract award and execution makes detection hard. Invoicing and payment are often manual and delayed. Disputes and reconciliation are costly.
opportunities: Audit trail of commitments, milestones, and payments can improve transparency and deter fraud. Smart contracts or programmable logic can release payment when attested milestones are met. Shared, verifiable records can streamline reconciliation.
